fusions.name: Ripple Link
fusions.desc: Flicks a bead of water that deals 4 damage, then leaps to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 50% of that.

fusions.name: Haul Yourself Over
fusions.desc: Casts a link at a target up to 6 tiles away and hauls you to it, dealing 14 damage, up to 1.5 times that at the far end of its reach. The target moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Slipped Shackles
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 conditions from you. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Brood in Tow
fusions.desc: A bonded hatchling follows you and fights beside you, striking enemies within 4 tiles for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds. Anything it strikes moves 15% slower for 2 seconds.
